title: A Wolf for the Ember
author: Ulyana Fairweather
blurb: Wendell Okafor, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has spent fifteen years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
